sentences.en: This painting is a representation of a storm at sea.
sentences.zh: 这幅画表现了一场海上风暴。

sentences.en: We have plenty of trans representation on the development team.
sentences.zh: 我们的开发团队中有足够的跨性别者代表。

sentences.en: Nowadays school is considered a representation of the world.
sentences.zh: 如今，学校被视为世界的缩影。
